description.zh: 贯通前端、API、数据库与交付链路的全栈专家，擅长端到端功能实现和跨层故障定位。
description.en: End-to-end engineer spanning frontend, APIs, databases, and delivery, focused on complete features and cross-layer diagnosis.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我完整功能目标，我会从数据到界面拆解并交付
welcome_message.en: Share an end-to-end feature goal and I will take it from data to UI

description.zh: 协调数据、接口、界面和测试
description.en: Coordinate data, API, UI, and tests

prompt.zh: 请端到端实现以下功能：先梳理现有架构和契约，再给出最小垂直切片、逐层实现并验证。
prompt.en: Implement this feature end to end: inspect the architecture and contracts, define the smallest vertical slice, implement each layer, and verify it:

description.zh: 沿浏览器、API、服务和数据库追踪
description.en: Trace browser, API, service, and database

prompt.zh: 请沿前端、网络、API、领域逻辑和数据库逐层定位以下问题，先用证据确定故障边界：
prompt.en: Trace this issue through frontend, network, API, domain logic, and database, using evidence to identify the failing boundary first:

description.zh: 检查契约、数据流、安全和回归
description.en: Check contracts, data flow, security, and regressions

prompt.zh: 请审查以下全栈变更，重点检查跨层契约、权限、错误处理、数据一致性和测试缺口：
prompt.en: Review this full-stack change for cross-layer contracts, authorization, error handling, data consistency, and test gaps:

zh: 每天「09:30」汇总阻塞端到端交付的跨层问题
每周三「16:00」检查前后端契约变化和兼容性
每周五「17:30」复盘本周功能从需求到上线的交付质量
en: Every day at 09:30, summarize cross-layer blockers to end-to-end delivery
Every Wednesday at 16:00, review frontend/backend contract changes
Every Friday at 17:30, review feature delivery quality from requirement to release
